name: trucktap
description: Local-first van restock desktop app, PWA, and Team Sync backend for field service teams.
author: TruckTap

scripts.dev:full: concurrently -k --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm run server:dev" "npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort"
scripts.server:start: npm run server:build && npm --prefix server run start
scripts.server:smoke: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix server run smoke
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k --names api,vite,electron --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,green "npm run server:dev" "npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort" "npm run desktop:electron"
scripts.desktop:electron: wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 http-get://127.0.0.1:8787/api/health && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.desktop:stack: concurrently -k --names api,desktop --prefix-colors magenta,green "npm run server:start" "npm run desktop:start"
scripts.mobile:build: cross-env VITE_API_URL=https://trucktap-blush.vercel.app npm run build && node scripts/prepare-mobile.mjs
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap open ios
